units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:5:8">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>קטר פּוֹרְתֵּיה לפורתיה</he> he tied his (R. Jacob’s) portion to his own.
<cite ref="Gittin 34b:6">Gitt. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>קרו … ופ׳ שרה</he> they called her Miriam, but a portion (some few people) called her Sarah; a. e.
<cite ref="Gittin 56b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>עד דרווח מיעיה פ׳ פ׳</he> until his (shrunken) bowels gradually extended.
